script_text: Stop scrolling, Taurus; your 1st House is about to explode today. Monday brings a square between Mercury and Mars, causing frustrating delays at work that test your Earth patience and budget. Tuesday is the hardest day because communication clashes with your home environment. Wednesday, however, flips the script as Venus aligns with your Sun in the 6th House, making it impossible to ignore romance. Thursday sees Venus trine Pluto in your 10th, unlocking a major career opportunity through a new friend. By Sunday, the Full Moon rises in your 1st House, forcing a hard truth about your self-worth and your monthly income. Wednesday is your power day because Venus activates your partnership sector. Tuesday is your worst day because a Mars square blocks your important career messages. As your ruling planet, Venus will reward your calm approach to the surrounding chaos. Follow for daily updates.
